newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: INSIGHT -NZ dollar recovers from overnight low.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -NZ dollar recovers from overnight low.

text.p: *DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
* NZ dollar opens firmer, recovers from overnight low
* European selling blamed for overnight dip
The Trade-Weighted Index was at 64.70, little changed from its 0.64.78 open and Thursday's 64.75 close.
"There seems to be selling interest around 0.6500-20 but I think we're probably going to range around 0.6480-10," said one Auckland dealer.
Next week's Household Labour Force Survey may have a profound impact on the Kiwi.
If the number is substantially weaker than Reserve Bank forecasts, it may open up room for more downside, he added.
